GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 312.1 (10 Jan 46) CIS
(SCAPIN - 573)
10 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Request for Presence of Japanese at Headquarters, United States Army Forces, Western Pacific.
The Imperial Japanese Government will:
A. Direct that Lieutenant General Nishio Kitajima and Mr. Kenjiro Shibata be prepared to depart from Tokyo on or about 12 January 1946 for Manila.
B. Insure that the above individuals are in Tokyo, ready to depart on the date specified.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
